adaptation.algorithm_identity: allowedAlgorithm q A := A = dobocK q pins DOBOC-K exactly (Algorithm 2 in component form with neighbour sums over N_i u {i}); the Convergence existential cannot choose another method.
adaptation.cost: Headline: the number of DOBOC-K outer iterations k (each iteration additionally performs K - 1 neighbour-communication rounds, which are internal computation and not counted). Template execution: one oracle (index 0) returning all agents' local gradients and Hessians at the queried stacked point, called once per iteration; budget p _ := p.k. execute_dobocK proves that the run with budget k returns iterate k.
adaptation.output: The output is the last iterate x_k (the state after k updates).
adaptation.probability: Deterministic: Unit seeds with Dirac laws; successful uses an almost-everywhere statement that holds pointwise.
adaptation.public_information: Public inputs (known to the algorithm): n, p (dim), graph G, weights W, lambda, eta, K, x0. Hidden instance: the local functions f_1..f_n, accessed only through the oracle. Assumption constants m, M, L and the iteration count k are parameters (Params) not used by the algorithm.
adaptation.source_correspondence: theorem2 (raw TH2) states 0 < epsilon < 1 and F(x_k) - F(x_*) <= (1 - epsilon)^k (F(x_0) - F(x_*)) for every minimiser x_* satisfying the step-size condition at Delta = F(x_0) - F(x_*); the public result obtains x_* from penalty_exists_minimizer (DMIN), the step-size condition from admissible (stated for every minimiser, the minimum value being unique) and the execution correspondence from execute_dobocK.

deferred_obligations.requirement: execute_dobocK: for an oracle answering localOracle at every query, execute O (dobocK q) (fun _ => k) seed xi = iterate q f k.
penalty_exists_minimizer: under Network, lambda > 0, m > 0 and Assumption1, F attains its minimum; used by result to discharge the existential in successful.
result combines penalty_exists_minimizer, theorem2 (with the admissible step-size condition at that minimiser) and execute_dobocK; allowedAlgorithm holds by rfl.

detail.construction: Stacked n dim := PiLp 2 (fun _ : Fin n => EuclideanSpace R (Fin dim)) is R^{np} with the Euclidean (product L2) inner product; LocalReply n dim := Fin n -> E x (E ->L[R] E) carries (grad f_i(x^i), grad^2 f_i(x^i)) of every agent. Public bundles the algorithm inputs n, dim (= source p), graph G with decidable adjacency, weights W, lambda (lam), eta, K, x0. mix q v := toLp (fun i => sum_{j in insert i (G.neighborFinset i)} W i j * v j) is the neighbour average sum_{j in N_i u {i}} w_ij v^j. localBase = ghat_0 (componentwise eta [grad f_i + (1/lambda)(x^i - mix x^i)]), innerStep = the source update of ghat_{t+1} from ghat_t (componentwise, including the (1 - eta/lambda), - eta grad^2 f_i and (eta/lambda) sum w_ij terms), direction = innerStep^[K-1] localBase = ghat_{K-1}, step x r = x - direction. dobocK q : Algorithm (Stacked) (LocalReply) (Stacked) 1 has state = current iterate, initial = x0, query x = (0, x), update = step, output = state. localOracle q f x is the exact reply (grad f_i(x^i), fderiv R (gradient f_i) (x^i)); iterate q f k := (fun x => step q x (localOracle q f x))^[k] x0 is the source sequence x_k. The final line attribute [local simp] ... only pre-generates equation lemmas (no simp-set change outside the module).
edge_cases: K = 0 is excluded by the setup's validity (K >= 1); direction then iterates K-1 >= 0 inner steps exactly as Algorithm 2 (t = 0..K-2).
The neighbour sums run over N_i u {i} literally; with W's sparsity they equal full sums (proved in Proofs).
